title: pre-push demands a full-suite pass for a commit that only changes findings/*.json
detail: After releasing 0.245.0, closing three findings (commit 7f2f1d1 touching only findings/fb-*.json) was blocked by the pre-push hook: tree ea2c1041 had no local suite pass. The parent tree d07ca16 had passed and CI was green; the only diff was ticket JSON, which no test imports. Re-running scripts/suite.sh cost 3m18s to push bookkeeping. Every release ends with this push. A tree whose diff from a suite-passed parent touches only files outside the test-input set (findings/) could carry the parent's pass, keyed to that computed diff, not to an agent claim.

resolution.verify: uv run python -m pytest tests/test_pre_push_suite_stamp.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
